expectations.title: Do not invent blocking findings for the performance fast path
expectations.rationale: The public PR was closed as superseded rather than for a correctness defect; this fixture protects precision on complex but intentional async/React code.

expectations.title: Flag operational details returned by a public health endpoint
expectations.rationale: The response includes process memory/uptime and can include service error messages; this is a labeled real-world security expectation even when no current deterministic rule maps to it yet.

findings.title: Operational health details exposed in a response

expectations.title: Do not report cross-project cache pollution after project-root keying
expectations.rationale: The final minimized behavior keys cached extensions by resolved project root, addressing the historical review issue.

expectations.title: Recognize executable project configuration as a trust boundary
expectations.rationale: Loading project configuration executes repository code and may register process-wide loaders; this should remain advisory unless stronger exploit evidence exists.

expectations.title: Preserve the CSP nonce on executable segment scripts
expectations.rationale: The PR fixes script tags emitted for loading/template/error segments that omitted ctx.nonce and were blocked under strict nonce CSPs.

findings.title: CSP nonce is not propagated to executable output

expectations.title: Forward the CSP nonce into the React streaming renderer
expectations.rationale: Without streamOptions.nonce, inline completion scripts for large Suspense boundaries are emitted without the request nonce.

findings.title: CSP nonce is not propagated to executable output

expectations.title: Enforce Server Action body limits while consuming Edge request streams
expectations.rationale: The affected Edge path consumed multipart and non-multipart bodies without honoring serverActions.bodySizeLimit, unlike the Node path.

expectations.title: Do not embed raw JSON.stringify output directly into a script tag
expectations.rationale: The merged follow-up explicitly removed an example where attacker-controlled serialized state could break out of the script element.

findings.title: Raw JSON embedded in a script element

expectations.title: Classify malformed request bodies separately from action execution failures
expectations.rationale: The PR separates decode errors from genuine server faults so malformed input returns a client error instead of polluting 5xx monitoring.

expectations.title: Do not flag redirect handling that delegates cross-origin targets to the guarded external fetch path
expectations.rationale: The reviewed change intentionally keeps private-IP validation on cross-origin redirects and bounds redirect depth.

expectations.title: Do not report zip-bomb risk when decompression enforces maxOutputLength
expectations.rationale: The reviewed fix handles gzip/deflate/brotli while applying an explicit decompressed-output bound.

expectations.title: Do not flag development-only origin inheritance as production CSRF relaxation
expectations.rationale: The reviewed change merges allowedDevOrigins only during development and leaves production resolution untouched.

expectations.title: Do not report the guarded adoption flow as silently granting fork code secrets
expectations.rationale: The script refuses non-interactive input and requires retyping the contributor handle before pushing code into a secrets-enabled branch.

expectations.title: Keep explicit review attention on the fork-to-privileged-branch transition
expectations.rationale: Even with a confirmation gate, adopting fork code changes the trust boundary and deserves human review.

expectations.title: Do not flag the transport merely for handling raw WebSocket frames when origin and payload bounds are explicit
expectations.rationale: The reviewed transport validates upgrade metadata and applies fixed per-connection payload and queue limits.

expectations.title: Do not flag a WebSocket route that validates authentication, exact origin, and payload size
expectations.rationale: The reviewed route-handler design makes the application trust boundary explicit and applies bounded transport semantics before acceptance.

expectations.title: Do not treat validated dev correlation hints as authoritative identity
expectations.rationale: The hardening rejects malformed values and derives Server Action classification from trusted framework evidence without retaining raw action IDs.

expectations.title: Do not report mutable foreground-state leakage after diagnostics state is reset
expectations.rationale: The reviewed implementation preserves safe route/build configuration while resetting metrics, cache invocation state, identity, errors, and after-context.

expectations.title: Preserve the request CSP nonce on loading, error, and template chunk scripts
expectations.rationale: The public fix adds ctx.nonce because otherwise strict nonce CSP blocks boundary scripts that are emitted independently.

findings.title: CSP nonce is not propagated to executable output

expectations.title: Do not report a long-lived credential leak when the workflow uses exact-audience OIDC and masks the token
expectations.rationale: The merged workflow uses short-lived OIDC, minimal permissions, pinned actions, sparse checkout, no persisted credentials, redirect rejection, and bounded requests.

expectations.title: Do not flag the guarded host rewrite as an unconditional forwarded-host trust
expectations.rationale: The rewrite requires the exact forwarding marker, Server Action request shape, a forwarded host, and arrival at the configured internal forwarding origin.

expectations.title: Keep reverse-proxy provenance of the unauthenticated forwarding marker under review
expectations.rationale: The PR explicitly notes a proxy topology can make a client-controlled forwarded host satisfy the guards; authenticating the marker would strengthen the boundary.

expectations.title: Do not report forwarded-host trust when redirect restoration is restricted to internal GET and RSC requests
expectations.rationale: The follow-up adds a distinct exact marker and requires GET, RSC, forwarded-host presence, and internal-origin host matching before rewriting.

expectations.title: Do not clear the previously loaded environment before a forced reread has produced replacement content
expectations.rationale: FIFO-mounted secret-manager env files may be consumed once; clearing process state first causes secret/config loss when the forced reread is empty.

findings.title: Environment state is replaced before reload succeeds

expectations.title: Refresh the exposed promise when a failed query retries
expectations.rationale: The PR fixes useQuery().promise retaining an obsolete promise when retry transitions the query back to fetching.

findings.title: Promise ref can stay stale across retry

expectations.title: Guard optional dehydrated state before hydrating on the client
expectations.rationale: The example could call hydrate with null/undefined state on client-only routes after the core runtime guard was removed.

findings.title: Nullable hydration state is dereferenced without a guard

expectations.title: Avoid a subscription gap that can lose cache updates during mount
expectations.rationale: The PR defers observer attachment until the conditional subtree is ready while preserving synchronous optimistic status.

findings.title: External store snapshot can miss an update before subscription

expectations.title: Keep devtools instance state isolated per provider
expectations.rationale: The PR moves instance-specific panel/selection/cache state into context because global sharing caused multiple devtools instances to interfere.

findings.title: Mutable module state leaks across React instances

expectations.title: Reconcile navigation state when history changes before hydration listeners attach
expectations.rationale: The merged fix detects that hydration started on a stale history entry and replays the missed traversal.

findings.title: Browser state can change before hydration subscribes

expectations.title: Preserve repeated URLSearchParams values when constructing client cache keys
expectations.rationale: Object.fromEntries drops repeated values, causing multi-value and single-value queries to collide and stale UI state to be reused.

findings.title: Repeated search parameters collapse in cache identity

expectations.title: Do not flag optional hydration collections that are intentionally supported
expectations.rationale: The merged change accepts partial dehydrated state and safely skips absent mutation/query arrays.

expectations.title: Do not invent production findings for test-only optimistic and concurrent mutation coverage
expectations.rationale: The merged PR changes only Vue Query tests and upstream review reported no actionable production risk.

expectations.title: Do not invent production hook findings for test-only pagination and reactivity coverage
expectations.rationale: The merged PR adds runtime and type-level tests only and explicitly carries no release impact.

expectations.title: Cancel and clear per-request query state when a server render is disposed
expectations.rationale: The merged feature adds server cleanup because finite gcTime can otherwise keep per-request clients and captured data alive after SSR disposal.

findings.title: Server cache teardown leaves per-request query state alive

expectations.title: Prefer Solid 2 native async projections over React-style observer notification mirroring
expectations.rationale: The merged rewrite removes the notification/store layer and delegates suspension, held values, error routing, and streaming hydration to Solid 2 primitives.

expectations.title: Allow cached dehydration to use the snapshot timestamp instead of reading Date.now()
expectations.rationale: The PR exists because Cache Components cannot prerender dehydrate() while the query serializer reads wall-clock time during the cached computation.

expectations.title: Keep manifest links in the document head even when other metadata streams later
expectations.rationale: The public fix moves manifest handling into eagerly emitted static metadata because browsers do not reliably detect a manifest emitted in the body.

findings.title: Web manifest is emitted through streamed body metadata

expectations.title: Do not reference a force-mode guard from a method that has no force parameter
expectations.rationale: The reviewed diff adds `if (!force && ...)` inside withSpan even though withSpan has no force parameter, making the fast-path patch invalid at typecheck/build time.

findings.title: Method guard references an unavailable identifier

expectations.title: Do not invent hook or rendering findings for a coordinated React package version bump
expectations.rationale: The merged change updates React, React DOM, scheduler, and generated bundle versions in lockstep without application hook behavior changes.

expectations.title: Do not invent lifecycle findings for a behavior-preserving deferred-promise consolidation
expectations.rationale: The merged refactor replaces duplicate implementations with one shared helper and validated the affected bundle and focused tests.

expectations.title: Do not invent production findings for documentation-only JSDoc and TypeDoc reference work
expectations.rationale: The merged PR is explicitly docs/CI/dev-only and does not change released runtime behavior.

expectations.title: Do not invent production findings for a documentation-generator configuration entry
expectations.rationale: The merged change only wires a TypeDoc entry point; upstream CI and automated review reported no actionable risk.

expectations.title: Do not invent runtime findings for documentation-only Vue Query JSDoc work
expectations.rationale: The merged PR is explicitly docs/CI/dev-only; runtime examples were corrected in prose and generated reference output without release behavior changes.

expectations.title: Keep digest computation and persistence off the HMR change-consumption path
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix loop awaited the server-content digest and wrote it to disk for every changed endpoint, serializing expensive persistence work inside the HMR stream.

expectations.title: Do not couple a coalesced image transform to one requester socket
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix optimizer passed the initiating request socket into shared request/response mocks, so that requester aborting could tear down the coalesced stream and wedge the cache key for later callers.

expectations.title: Compare cache-entry age with the tag revalidation time
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix predicate checked only whether a tag was pending, incorrectly discarding cache entries that were created after that tag was revalidated.

expectations.title: Retain completed request-scoped cache entries for the request lifetime
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix cleanup deleted the fill-map entry as soon as the promise settled, causing sequential identical cache calls in one request to repeat the work.

expectations.title: Do not classify route-filter changes as global environment changes
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix watcher set envChange for a router-filter change, triggering global reload and cache invalidation for unrelated route edits.

expectations.title: Return before allocating rewrite state when no rewrites exist
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix handler cloned request state and created matching closures before discovering that all rewrite arrays were empty.

expectations.title: Serialize read-modify-write updates to the prerender manifest
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix development server let concurrent generateStaticParams tasks read, mutate, and write the same JSON manifest without synchronization, allowing torn or lost updates.

expectations.title: Preserve every repeated --require and --import option
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix parser stored NODE_OPTIONS in a scalar record, so later --require or --import occurrences overwrote earlier values before workers were forked.

expectations.title: Remove per-proxy close listeners when the proxy settles
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix proxy attached close listeners to the response but did not remove them on completion, so a reused response accumulated listeners.

expectations.title: Skip lazy-chunk materialization unless deferred chunks are enabled
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix hot reloader invoked the expensive project.materializeLazyChunk N-API operation for every static chunk request even when the feature flag was off.

expectations.title: Derive foreground revalidation from the current cache consumer
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix nested cache scope inherited its parent's foreground-revalidation need, allowing a fresh outer cache entry to persist a stale inner value.

expectations.title: Register the app directory as a dependency on loader cache hits
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix loader called addContextDependency only while populating its compilation cache; cache-hit invocations omitted the dependency and could retain a stale HMR route tree.

expectations.title: Preserve route-miss semantics when a development refresh fails
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix matcher awaited refresh without handling rejection, so a missing route intended to return 404 could escape as a 500 response.

expectations.title: Compare root-layout directories instead of normalized route ancestry
expectations.rationale: The pre-fix ancestry filter normalized one layout to '/', falsely treating a sibling locale root layout as a descendant and dropping its root parameters.

expectations.title: Reject use-server modules outside the App Router graph
expectations.rationale: The offending TypeScript contract was a top-level 'use server' module reachable only from the Pages Router, where it was silently treated as an action instead of rejected.

expectations.title: Do not flag a user-triggered asynchronous dynamic import
expectations.rationale: The reviewed test application intentionally loads the target from an onClick handler and stores it in component state to verify safe client-side lazy compilation.

expectations.title: Do not infer runtime cost from an optional boolean schema field
expectations.rationale: The reviewed source is only the z.boolean().optional() declaration for turbopackMangleExportNames and contains no execution or resource-management behavior.

expectations.title: Do not flag exhaustive foreground-revalidation derivation
expectations.rationale: The reviewed final implementation uses an exhaustive WorkUnitStore.type switch and safely derives foreground revalidation without reading a removed execution mode.

expectations.title: Do not report the corrected route-aware Error factories
expectations.rationale: The reviewed final code centralizes literal cache error messages, includes the route context, and retains the original cause; earlier review concerns were fixed.

expectations.title: Do not flag the corrected Pages runtime trace aggregation
expectations.rationale: The reviewed final Webpack-only path performs node-file-trace, merges the ESM file list, and returns the traced runtime assets; the reviewer concern was resolved.

expectations.title: Do not flag a route probe that exits on absence or error
expectations.rationale: The reviewed final loop verifies that the route file exists, asks project.containsRoute, breaks on false or error, and only then waits for the entrypoint update.

expectations.title: Do not report unique-symbol route branding as unsafe conversion
expectations.rationale: The reviewed final types brand TurbopackRouteKey and AppEntryName with distinct unique symbols and carry them through typed maps for compile-time namespace safety.

expectations.title: Do not flag the reviewed recursive route-tree unification
expectations.rationale: The reviewed final representation safely recurses through RouteTree and CacheNodeSeedData while preserving optional RSC payloads and parallel route slots.

expectations.title: Do not report the deliberate recursive transport-tree zipper
expectations.rationale: The reviewed final adapter deliberately combines FlightRouterState and seed data into keyed TransportNode maps while preserving optional child data.

expectations.title: Do not flag behavior-preserving stale revalidation propagation
expectations.rationale: The reviewed final exhaustive work-unit switch removes execution-mode reads while preserving foreground stale-revalidation propagation for cache and prerender variants.
